senses.gloss: Taṭiskandha, m. or nt., n. of a locality: Māy 〔47〕.

taṭṭa, taṭṭu, taṭṭuka (m. or nt.; = Pali taṭṭaka, a flattish bowl; otherwise unrecorded), some kind of bowl [] or dish: taṭṭukaṃ (acc.) Śikṣ 〔58.1〕; taṭṭa-kāra, bowl-maker, Mv 〔ii.468.14, 18〕; 〔iii.442.17〕 (here mss. tadva˚, Senart wrongly em. taddhu˚); taṭṭu-kāraka, id., Mv 〔iii.113.13〕 (so read for taddhu˚); taṭṭv-ākāra, bowl-shaped, to be read in Divy 〔342.26〕; 〔343.5〕, for text tapv-āk˚; this passage cited Śikṣ 〔58.1〕 taṭṭākāra (taṭṭa-āk˚), but 〔58.5〕 taṭṭukākāra (taṭṭuka-āk˚); miswritten khaṭvākāra, see khaṭu (2).
